description: Create or update a persistent project note by key for strategy, research findings, decisions and their reasons, or rejected approaches. Existing keys are updated instead of duplicated. pinned=true includes up to the five newest pinned notes, with dates, in content-planning context; dashboard settings take precedence on conflict. Limits: 200 notes per project and 50,000 characters per body. Setup and endpoint behavior: https://motiblog.ai/mcp.

key.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, e.g. "content-strategy-q4" — saving to an existing key updates it

kind.description: What kind of memory this is (default: note)

pinned.description: true = inject into the content-planning prompt (durable strategy only)

project_id.description: MotiBlog project id permitted by the current credential. Omit when a default project is configured.

title.description: Human-readable title, shown in the index and dashboard

name: save_note
title: Save Agent Note
